notes.hook: Comparing NASA's first rover to a microwave is an immediate, highly visual curiosity hook.
notes.clarity: Clean, tight chronological narrative explaining how it landed, survived, and proved ancient water on Mars.
notes.payoff: Connecting the 1997 microrover to a tribute etched onto Perseverance gives a satisfying full-circle payoff.
notes.visuals: Historic imagery of Sojourner on Mars is wonderful, though beat 7's Perseverance selfie lacks a clear view of the etched silhouette.
notes.loop: Brings the story back to the microwave comparison cleanly, though repeating the word 'microwave' back-to-back across the seam feels slightly repetitive.

rounds.better_than_last: The opening hook uses a relatable everyday object to deliver a much faster, more visual hook than ep436 and ep439.
